test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT in relation to Self - Balancing Ledger system?

options.text: Various works can be done quickly as this system provides sub - division of work among the different employees.
Committing fraud is minimised as different ledgers are prepared by different clerks.
If ledgers are maintained under self-balancing system, it becomes very easy to locate errors.
This system is particularly useful where there are a limited / smaller number of customers or suppliers.

solution:
The correct answer is** This system is particularly useful where there are a limited / smaller number of customers or suppliers.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **This system is particularly useful where there are a limited / smaller number of customers or suppliers:**

 
 
• This statement is incorrect because the self-balancing ledger system is particularly beneficial in large organizations with numerous customers and suppliers. It allows for the efficient handling of large volumes of transactions by dividing the work among multiple employees and departments.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Various works can be done quickly as this system provides sub-division of work among the different employees:**

 
 
• This statement is correct. The self-balancing ledger system facilitates the subdivision of work, allowing different employees to manage different ledgers. This division enhances efficiency and speeds up the process of managing financial records.
 
 
 
• **Committing fraud is minimized as different ledgers are prepared by different clerks:**
 
 
• This statement is correct. By having different clerks responsible for different ledgers, the chances of committing fraud are reduced. This segregation of duties adds a layer of internal control, making it harder for any single employee to manipulate financial records without detection.
 
 
 
• **If ledgers are maintained under self-balancing system, it becomes very easy to locate errors:**
 
 
• This statement is correct. The self-balancing ledger system makes it easier to locate errors because each ledger is balanced independently. This means that discrepancies can be quickly identified and traced back to the specific ledger where the error occurred.
